candidates.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make the single authorized targeted correction to H402 growth frame. Image1 is current H402v02 EDIT TARGET, Image2 approved H403v02 PEAK reference, Image3 accepted H401 START reference. Current target still has too-long LEFT tail and too much bright area, nearly the peak. Redraw ONLY the compact growth effect with this STRICT spatial envelope: square canvas unchanged, black opaque background; ALL visible smoke, glints, head and halo must fit between x=0.49 and x=0.82 of canvas width, y=0.44 and y=0.56 of canvas height. Tail begins just at canvas center (x0.50,y0.50); bright tip is at x0.80,y0.50. Absolutely no smoke/glint/tail left of x0.48 or past x0.83. This is an intermediate start-to-peak progression, NOT peak size: slightly larger than START Image3, much shorter and dimmer than PEAK Image2, around60% of peak forward reach. Keep right-facing torn wispy painted white/gray smoke and three tiny understated abstract mask glints consistent with references. Keep origin at canvas center; do not shrink/crop/recenter the canvas or add bars. Remove the extra long tail instead of keeping it faint. Do not reproduce full arrow size from Image1. Request1024x1024. No color, transparency, character, weapon, text, border or scene. One frame only.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: isolated 2D game VFX, LAST dissipation frame H406 for Sylas shadow dash. Image 1 is edit target H406v01; Image 2 is accepted previous BREAK phase H405v01; Image 3 is immutable approved H403v02 PEAK for painted white/gray STYLE ONLY, never recreate its head or brightness. Replace coherent luminous arrowhead, continuous smoke ribbon and intact mask glints with only a FEW tiny very faint gray torn wisps/fragments and specks in the residual locations of Image2. This is the final almost-black instant: much dimmer/sparser than H405, no recognizable head, no continuous stroke, no intact mask face or eyes, no bright core, no renewed growth. Square1024x1024, exact BLACK opaque background, no transparency; almost all canvas pure black. Preserve central origin and rightward spatial context, top-down flat orientation, safe black margins. Do not merely lower opacity while keeping the full arrow shape: break/remove that silhouette. No character/body/weapon/text/border/scenery/color/new motif.
